priorities.summary: A vendor-scored 10.0 pre-authentication SSRF/unintended-proxy flaw in the Work Place interface of SonicWall SMA1000 appliances (models 6210, 7210, 8200v), letting unauthenticated remote attackers reach internal functionality. The third pre-auth SSRF patched in this same interface in 2026; fixed in 12.4.3-03670 / 12.5.0-03082.

A 9.9 OS command injection (CWE-78) in Langflow's MCP server handling: pre-1.10.3 versions executed user-supplied MCP stdio command/args fields wrapped in bash -c with no allowlist. With Langflow's default LANGFLOW_AUTO_LOGIN=true, internet-exposed instances were exploitable without credentials. Fixed in Langflow 1.10.3; a public PoC exists.

Cisco disclosed an unauthenticated RCE flaw in MPLS OAM on Nexus 3000 and standalone-mode Nexus 9000 switches; a crafted MPLS echo request can yield root-level code execution or force a reload. MPLS OAM is disabled by default, which limits exposure; Cisco released fixes plus a Live Protect shield.

model.name: OpenAI GPT-6 with Intelligent UI
model.summary: OpenAI rolled GPT-6 into ChatGPT for all tiers on Oct 7-8, adding "Intelligent UI" - answers composed from text, visuals, charts, forms and interactive tools the user can operate inline, with answers starting to stream 44% sooner. It shifts ChatGPT from a text chatbot toward a task-specific software generator.
